source.name: OpenStreetMap contributors via BBBike Lisbon extract

selection.method: Mapped locality/street sample using geographic-cell round-robin, prioritising towns/suburbs, core tourist district/street names, pedestrian streets and major roads; same-name connected ways merged by shared OSM nodes.

limitations: An offline sample of mapped names, not an exhaustive address geocoder.
Street focus positions lie along mapped routes near their centroids; place ways use approximate centroids. Neither establishes a surveyed entrance or address.
Names and mappings can be incomplete or outdated. Google is not the source of this index.
